title: Decoding state advances by one
statement: For every binary word $w$ and every natural number $j$, one decoding step applied to the state for $w$ at count $j$ gives the state for $w$ at count $j+1$.
replaced: For every binary target $w$ and count $j$, one decoding step on the state at $(w, j)$ yields exactly the state at $(w, j+1)$; no decoded value is used as a loop clock, the supplied unary budget being the only repetition count.
